/**
 * A formatter created on first use: breaks the construction cycle of mutually recursive generic types.
 * @param {() => import('@dtronix/nexnet').Formatter<any>} create
 */
function $lazy(create) {
  /** @type {import('@dtronix/nexnet').Formatter<any> | null} */
  let f = null;
  return Object.freeze({
    write(w, v) {
      (f ??= create()).write(w, v);
    },
    read(r) {
      return (f ??= create()).read(r);
    },
  });
}

/**
 * The formatter of a C# T[] (isArray) or List<T> of a type parameter: as C# does once T is bound, an ext 78
 * primitive array for the primitive element formatters, bin for byte[], otherwise an array of elements. The
 * value is a JS array either way.
 * @param {import('@dtronix/nexnet').Formatter<any>} element
 * @param {boolean} isArray
 */
function $seq(element, isArray) {
  /** @type {[import('@dtronix/nexnet').Formatter<any>, import('@dtronix/nexnet').Formatter<any>, any, string][]} */
  const packed = [
    [$rt.sbyteFormatter, $rt.int8ArrayFormatter, Int8Array, 'int'],
    [$rt.int16Formatter, $rt.int16ArrayFormatter, Int16Array, 'int'],
    [$rt.uint16Formatter, $rt.uint16ArrayFormatter, Uint16Array, 'int'],
    [$rt.int32Formatter, $rt.int32ArrayFormatter, Int32Array, 'int'],
    [$rt.uint32Formatter, $rt.uint32ArrayFormatter, Uint32Array, 'int'],
    [$rt.int64Formatter, $rt.int64ArrayFormatter, BigInt64Array, 'int'],
    [$rt.uint64Formatter, $rt.uint64ArrayFormatter, BigUint64Array, 'int'],
    [$rt.float32Formatter, $rt.float32ArrayFormatter, Float32Array, 'float'],
    [$rt.float64Formatter, $rt.float64ArrayFormatter, Float64Array, 'float'],
    [$rt.halfFormatter, $rt.halfArrayFormatter, Float32Array, 'float'],
    [$rt.charFormatter, $rt.charArrayFormatter, Uint16Array, 'char'],
  ];
  if (isArray) packed.push([$rt.byteFormatter, $rt.binFormatter, Uint8Array, 'int']);
  const entry = packed.find((p) => p[0] === element);
  if (entry === undefined) return $rt.arrayFormatter(element);
  const [, formatter, ArrayType, kind] = entry;
  return Object.freeze({
    /** @param {import('@dtronix/nexnet').MsgPackWriter} w @param {any} v */
    write(w, v) {
      if (v === null || v === undefined) {
        w.writeNil();
        return;
      }
      const items = Array.from(v);
      if (kind === 'char') {
        formatter.write(w, Uint16Array.from(items, (c) => {
          if (typeof c !== 'string' || c.length !== 1) throw new TypeError('char must be a string of one UTF-16 code unit');
          return c.charCodeAt(0);
        }));
        return;
      }
      const array = ArrayType.from(items);
      if (kind === 'int') {
        for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
          if (array[i] !== items[i]) throw new RangeError('element ' + i + ' (' + String(items[i]) + ') is not a value of the element type');
        }
      }
      formatter.write(w, array);
    },
    /** @param {import('@dtronix/nexnet').MsgPackReader} r */
    read(r) {
      const array = formatter.read(r);
      if (array === null) return null;
      return kind === 'char' ? Array.from(array, (c) => String.fromCharCode(c)) : Array.from(array);
    },
  });
}

/** The formatter of `BigCircle` (C# `Feat.BigCircle`). */
export const BigCircleFormatter = Object.freeze({
  write(w, v) {
    if (v === null || v === undefined) {
      w.writeNil();
      return;
    }
    w.writeArrayHeader(2);
    $rt.float64Formatter.write(w, v.radius);
    $rt.stringFormatter.write(w, v.label);
  },
  read(r) {
    if (r.tryReadNil()) {
      return null;
    }
    r.enter();
    const n = r.readArrayHeader();
    let m0 = 0;
    let m1 = null;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      switch (i) {
        case 0:
          m0 = $rt.float64Formatter.read(r);
          break;
        case 1:
          m1 = $rt.stringFormatter.read(r);
          break;
        default:
          r.skip();
          break;
      }
    }
    r.exit();
    return new $BigCircle({ radius: m0, label: m1 });
  },
});

/**
 * Creates the formatter of `Holder` (C# `Feat.Holder`) for the type arguments.
 *
 * @param {import('@dtronix/nexnet').Formatter<any>} f0 The formatter of `T`.
 */
export function HolderFormatter(f0) {
  const $self = Object.freeze({
    write(w, v) {
      if (v === null || v === undefined) {
        w.writeNil();
        return;
      }
      w.writeArrayHeader(4);
      $l0.write(w, v.items);
      $l1.write(w, v.array);
      $l2.write(w, v.plain);
      f0.write(w, v.value);
    },
    read(r) {
      if (r.tryReadNil()) {
        return null;
      }
      r.enter();
      const n = r.readArrayHeader();
      let m0 = null;
      let m1 = null;
      let m2 = null;
      let m3 = null;
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        switch (i) {
          case 0:
            m0 = $l0.read(r);
            break;
          case 1:
            m1 = $l1.read(r);
            break;
          case 2:
            m2 = $l2.read(r);
            break;
          case 3:
            m3 = f0.read(r);
            break;
          default:
            r.skip();
            break;
        }
      }
      r.exit();
      return new $Holder({ items: m0, array: m1, plain: m2, value: m3 });
    },
  });
  const $l0 = $seq(f0, false);
  const $l1 = $seq(f0, true);
  const $l2 = $rt.arrayFormatter(f0);
  return $self;
}

/** The formatter of `Huge` (C# `Feat.Huge`). A value type: null is refused. */

  write(w, v) {
    if (v === null || v === undefined) {
      throw new TypeError('Huge is a value type and cannot be null.');
    }
    $rt.uint64Formatter.write(w, v);
  },
  read(r) {
    return $rt.uint64Formatter.read(r);
  },
});

/** The formatter of `IEvent` (C# `Feat.IEvent`). */
export const IEventFormatter = Object.freeze({
  write(w, v) {
    if (v === null || v === undefined) {
      w.writeNil();
      return;
    }
    if (v instanceof $Spot) {
      w.writeArrayHeader(2);
      w.writeInt(1);
      SpotFormatter.write(w, v);
      return;
    }
    if (v instanceof $Note) {
      w.writeArrayHeader(2);
      w.writeInt(0);
      NoteFormatter.write(w, v);
      return;
    }
    throw new TypeError('The value is not a case of the union IEvent.');
  },
  read(r) {
    if (r.tryReadNil()) {
      return null;
    }
    r.enter();
    r.readArrayHeader(2);
    const tag = r.readUInt16();
    let v;
    switch (tag) {
      case 0:
        v = NoteFormatter.read(r);
        break;
      case 1:
        v = SpotFormatter.read(r);
        break;
      default:
        throw new $rt.NexusSerializationError('value', 'Unknown tag ' + tag + ' of the union IEvent.');
    }
    r.exit();
    return v;
  },
});

/** The formatter of `Shape` (C# `Feat.Shape`). */
export const ShapeFormatter = Object.freeze({
  write(w, v) {
    if (v === null || v === undefined) {
      w.writeNil();
      return;
    }
    if (v instanceof $BigCircle) {
      w.writeArrayHeader(2);
      w.writeInt(1);
      BigCircleFormatter.write(w, v);
      return;
    }
    if (v instanceof $Circle) {
      w.writeArrayHeader(2);
      w.writeInt(0);
      CircleFormatter.write(w, v);
      return;
    }
    if (v instanceof $Square) {
      w.writeArrayHeader(2);
      w.writeInt(2);
      SquareFormatter.write(w, v);
      return;
    }
    throw new TypeError('The value is not a case of the union Shape.');
  },
  read(r) {
    if (r.tryReadNil()) {
      return null;
    }
    r.enter();
    r.readArrayHeader(2);
    const tag = r.readUInt16();
    let v;
    switch (tag) {
      case 0:
        v = CircleFormatter.read(r);
        break;
      case 1:
        v = BigCircleFormatter.read(r);
        break;
      case 2:
        v = SquareFormatter.read(r);
        break;
      default:
        throw new $rt.NexusSerializationError('value', 'Unknown tag ' + tag + ' of the union Shape.');
    }
    r.exit();
    return v;
  },
});

/**
 * Creates the formatter of `Tree` (C# `Feat.Tree`) for the type arguments.

 * @param {import('@dtronix/nexnet').Formatter<any>} f0 The formatter of `T`.

export function TreeFormatter(f0) {

    write(w, v) {
      if (v === null || v === undefined) {
        w.writeNil();

        return null;

      r.enter();
      const n = r.readArrayHeader();

  });
  const $l0 = $rt.arrayFormatter($self);
  return $self;
}

/**
 * Structural equality of generated values, as C# compares the values they map: generated objects by class and
 * members, arrays and typed arrays element-wise, Map and Set by content, the runtime value types by their
 * equals, NaN equal to NaN.
 */
export declare function equalsValue(a: unknown, b: unknown): boolean;

/** A string that is the same for values {@link equalsValue} finds equal: a Map or Set key for the value. */
export declare function hashKeyOf(value: unknown): string;
// ==== nexnet-support.js
// <auto-generated> NexNet <version> (JavaScript target). Do not edit.
import * as $rt from '@dtronix/nexnet';

/**
 * Structural equality of generated values, as C# compares the values they map: generated objects by class and
 * members, arrays and typed arrays element-wise, Map and Set by content, the runtime value types by their
 * equals, NaN equal to NaN. Other objects compare by identity.
 * @param {unknown} a
 * @param {unknown} b
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function equalsValue(a, b) {
  if (a === b) return true;
  if (typeof a === 'number' && typeof b === 'number') return Number.isNaN(a) && Number.isNaN(b);
  if (a === null || b === null || typeof a !== 'object' || typeof b !== 'object') return false;
  const x = /** @type {any} */ (a);
  const y = /** @type {any} */ (b);
  if (typeof x.equals === 'function') return Boolean(x.equals(y));
  if (Array.isArray(x)) {
    if (!Array.isArray(y) || x.length !== y.length) return false;
    for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) if (!equalsValue(x[i], y[i])) return false;
    return true;
  }
  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(x)) {
    if (!ArrayBuffer.isView(y) || x.constructor !== y.constructor || x.length !== y.length) return false;
    for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) if (x[i] !== y[i] && !(Number.isNaN(x[i]) && Number.isNaN(y[i]))) return false;
    return true;
  }
  if (x instanceof Map) {
    if (!(y instanceof Map) || x.size !== y.size) return false;
    for (const [k, v] of x) {
      if (y.has(k)) {
        if (!equalsValue(v, y.get(k))) return false;
        continue;
      }
      let found = false;
      for (const [k2, v2] of y) {
        if (equalsValue(k, k2)) {
          found = equalsValue(v, v2);
          break;
        }
      }
      if (!found) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
  if (x instanceof Set) {
    if (!(y instanceof Set) || x.size !== y.size) return false;
    for (const k of x) {
      if (y.has(k)) continue;
      let found = false;
      for (const k2 of y) {
        if (equalsValue(k, k2)) {
          found = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (!found) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/** @type {WeakMap<object, number>} */
const identities = new WeakMap();
let nextIdentity = 0;

/**
 * A string that is the same for values {@link equalsValue} finds equal: a Map or Set key for the value.
 * Objects compared by identity get a key unique to the object.
 * @param {unknown} value
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function hashKeyOf(value) {
  switch (typeof value) {
    case 'undefined':
      return 'u';
    case 'boolean':
      return value ? 't' : 'f';
    case 'number':
      return 'n:' + (value === 0 ? '0' : String(value));
    case 'bigint':
      return 'b:' + String(value);
    case 'string':
      return 's:' + JSON.stringify(value);
    case 'function':
    case 'symbol':
      return 'x:' + String(value);
  }
  if (value === null) return 'null';
  const x = /** @type {any} */ (value);
  if (typeof x.hashKey === 'function') return String(x.hashKey());
  if (Array.isArray(x)) return '[' + x.map(hashKeyOf).join(',') + ']';
  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(x)) return x.constructor.name + '[' + Array.from(/** @type {any} */ (x), hashKeyOf).join(',') + ']';
  if (x instanceof Map) return 'M{' + Array.from(x, ([k, v]) => hashKeyOf(k) + '=' + hashKeyOf(v)).sort().join(',') + '}';
  if (x instanceof Set) return 'S{' + Array.from(x, hashKeyOf).sort().join(',') + '}';
  if (x instanceof $rt.NexusDecimal) {
    // Numeric equality: 1.0 and 1.00 are equal, and so are 0 and -0.
    if (x.magnitude === 0n) return 'd:0';
    let magnitude = x.magnitude;
    let scale = x.scale;
    while (scale > 0 && magnitude % 10n === 0n) {
      magnitude /= 10n;
      scale--;
    }
    return 'd:' + (x.negative ? '-' : '') + String(magnitude) + 'e-' + String(scale);
  }
  if (x instanceof $rt.NexusDateTime) return 'dt:' + String(x.ticks) + ':' + String(x.kind);
  if (x instanceof $rt.NexusDateTimeOffset) return 'dto:' + String(x.utcTicks);
  if (x instanceof $rt.NexusTimeSpan) return 'ts:' + String(x.ticks);
  if (x instanceof $rt.NexusDateOnly) return 'do:' + String(x.dayNumber);
  if (x instanceof $rt.NexusTimeOnly) return 'to:' + String(x.ticks);
  if (x instanceof $rt.NexusVersion) return 'v:' + String(x);
  let id = identities.get(x);
  if (id === undefined) {
    id = ++nextIdentity;
    identities.set(x, id);
  }
  return '#' + String(id);
}// ==== user-formatters.d.ts
